integrity: The characteristic equation, coefficient definitions, zero-delay stability setup, common-delay theorem, and Figure 2 parameter set were read in the primary full text. The proof was reconstructed from the displayed characteristic equation and independently checked by direct substitution and a standalone numerical verifier. General Lambert-\(W\) literature was used only for comparison and support, not as a substitute for the model-specific derivation.
scientific_limitations: The result is a local linear stability theorem for an interior equilibrium under the common-delay restriction. It does not prove nonlinear Hopf criticality, periodic-orbit stability, unequal-delay stability, or global competition outcomes. At \(\Delta=0\) the critical characteristic pair is algebraically multiple.
title: Exact common-delay stability threshold for the delayed Beverton–Holt coexistence equilibrium
